red_king.name: The Red King
red_king.description: A three-act invasion campaign featuring unstable dimensions, demonic opponents, unusual treasure and isolated warbands. Playtest edition: some advanced interactions and player choices use digital approximations.

red_king_squatter: Explore a three-room ruined dwelling and retrieve treasure guarded by a sleeping troll.
The troll awakens when a warband approaches. Entering its central chamber requires a Will test, and berserkers arrive from the corners during the first six turns.
red_king_investigations: Search ritual offerings around a barbarian camp before the guards overwhelm you.
The guards remain dormant until alerted. Search the stands to reveal treasure or traps; after turn three, each warband must escape via its new assigned edges.
red_king_veil: Escape through a receding dimensional barrier while hostile forces arrive from both sides.
Touching the veil is fatal. Escape via the opposite short edge. Opposing creatures can return after defeat.
red_king_back_into_fire: Infiltrate a ruined temple and recover the locked artefact before Hrut emerge from its portals.
Begin invisible. Unlock the central stand with a Will test (TN16); thieves, treasure hunters and casters gain +5. Portal contact causes elemental damage. Exit through corner doors.
red_king_demons_and_mad_man: The Demons and the Mad Man
Capture a fleeing survivor of ancient Felstad while Hrut hunting parties enter the ruins.

Only melee damage can render Ryce unconscious. Carry him off as an objective; at the end of turn two, each side receives a temporary Hrut hunting party. Repeated reality cracks exchange opposite edge regions.
red_king_mind: In the Mind of Kalamon Ryce
Enter a fractured mind alone and gather memories while mindshrikes converge.
Eight turns, three actions per turn with at most one move. Touch memories to secure them immediately. An event changes the board after each turn; defeat does not require a survival roll.
red_king_herded: Race toward the inner city as Hrut guard abandoned treasure and the veil closes behind you.
The veil advances 2–6 inches each turn. Fully engulfed figures are removed; partial contact causes 6 unavoidable damage. Sight is limited to 12 inches; escape south.
red_king_sinkhole: Recover treasure surrounding a pocket of anti-magic while Nullmen emerge from its darkness.
The orb draws figures and loose treasure inward each turn. Contact strips active spells and deals damage; casting becomes harder closer to the orb.
red_king_hill: Challenge the Herald and its winged Hrut guards before a reality crack folds the battlefield.

The Herald protects the central treasure. A reality crack divides the table into four slopes: sight cannot cross their seams unless the observer is near the summit. Second moves and attack damage require balance tests; failed tests send figures downhill.
red_king_tethers: Destroy five dimensional anchors guarded by berserkers.

Each pylon can be destroyed in melee or by magical shooting. Hrut emerge from surviving pylons. At the end of turn two the table folds into three connected strips; destroy every pylon before escaping.
red_king_bridge: Cross the dimensional void through a narrow bridge defended by Hrut.
The veil changes position each turn, blocking movement and sight for warbands but not Hrut. Forced movement into the void requires a Move test (TN16). Escape only from the bridge's far edge.
red_king_ringworld: Destroy the four Key-Masters in a mirrored pocket dimension.

Switch between inside and outside using a movement action. Short edges wrap; escape through contact with a living Key-Master. Destroy all four to save Frostgrave, but anyone remaining is permanently lost.

_note: Core Frostgrave 2e is always enabled. Development packs are visible but cannot be enabled until ready.
